{"path": "neuron_growth_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html", "edit_description": "Create a complete, self-contained single-file HTML page implementing an animated neon neuron network growth simulation on an 800x800 canvas centered on a dark background.

STRUCTURE / REQUIREMENTS:
- One HTML file, everything inline: HTML, CSS, vanilla JS, and dat.gui loaded from a CDN via a single <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js"></script> tag. No other external libraries, frameworks, modules, or assets. No images or textures.
- Canvas exactly 800x800, centered via CSS flexbox on a dark page background (#05070f), with a soft radial background glow (#101a3a) behind it. Add a subtle CSS box-shadow glow around the canvas.
- Page has a small title/status overlay with UI accent color #ffd400, and a status line showing "GROWING"/"STABLE"/"PAUSED" and node/synapse counts. Keep it minimal.

EXACT NEON PALETTE (use as dat.gui defaults):
- Background: #05070f
- Background glow: #101a3a
- Main branch color: #00e5ff
- Secondary branch accent: #d6ff00
- Synapse color: #ff2bd6
- Pulse color: #fff36a
- UI/accent color: #ffd400
- Optional dark grid/scanline color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)
Look: futuristic, high contrast, glowing, slightly gritty. Use canvas shadowBlur for all neon glow. Never mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style in code or comments.

SIMULATION LOGIC (separate clearly-commented sections: setup, GUI setup, neuron growth, synapse detection, pulse animation, rendering):
- On regenerate: create 3-6 random seed neurons near the canvas center (small random offset radius). Each seed has an initial direction angle and a root branch.
- Growth is ANIMATED step-by-step, not instant: each frame, advance growing branch tips by a small increment based on params.growthSpeed. A branch grows from its start point toward a target point using a quadratic curve (control point offset perpendicular to the direction, magnitude scaled by params.curvature) so shapes are organic and smooth.
- Each growing branch has: start {x,y}, end {x,y}, ctrl {x,y}, depth, thickness (randomly varied slightly, e.g. base * (0.7..1.3)), progress (0..1), color type (main or accent), and an id.
- When a branch finishes growing (progress reaches 1), with probability params.splitChance spawn 1-2 child branches (if depth < params.maxDepth and totalBranches < a global cap like 900). Child branches start at the parent's end, inherit depth+1, thinner thickness, and get a slightly randomized direction (parent angle + random spread). Occasionally generate smaller side branches: with some probability, spawn a short child mid-way along the parent.
- Branch length: each new branch length is random in range [maxLen*0.5, maxLen] using params.maxBranchLength. Enforce maxBranchDepth and a global total branch cap to keep performance stable.
- Growth stops when no branches are growing (network stable). Set status to STABLE but keep the animation loop alive.

CONNECTIONS / SYNAPSES:
- After each branch finishes growing, check its tip against all existing finished branch tips. If distance < params.synapseDistance, create a synapse connecting the two tips.
- Prevent duplicates: store synapses in an array and check that no synapse already exists between the same pair of branch ids (use a Set of "idA-idB" keys) and avoid self/very-close-parent connections.
- Synapses glow softly and pulse over time (sinusoidal alpha/radius modulation scaled by params.synapseGlow). Synapses must glow brighter than branches.

PULSES:
- After (and during) generation, spawn pulses that travel along synapses. A pulse stores the synapse reference, t (0..1), speed from params.pulseSpeed, and brightness from params.pulseBrightness.
- Spawn rate governed by params.pulseFrequency (e.g. accumulate a timer; spawn when timer exceeds 1/frequency) so random paths light up over time.
- Pulses move smoothly by interpolating between the two synapse endpoints (t += speed * dt). When t >= 1, remove the pulse (and optionally spawn a follow-up pulse on a random synapse attached to that node, to make paths feel alive). Also randomly pick different synapses over time.

RENDERING (each frame, requestAnimationFrame, clear then redraw):
- Fill background with params.backgroundColor, then draw a soft radial background glow (params.bgGlow, default #101a3a) and a faint vignette (radial gradient dark at edges) around the canvas borders.
- Optional subtle scanlines: horizontal lines every ~3px with rgba(0,229,255,0.08) at low alpha, plus a very subtle animated noise/grain effect drawn cheaply (e.g. a few dozen random low-alpha dots per frame, or a slowly moving scanline band). Keep it lightweight.
- Draw branches as thin glowing neon lines using quadraticCurveTo for the curved shape (draw only the grown portion using interpolation of the quadratic curve up to `progress`). Use params.branchColor for main branches and params.accentBranchColor for accent branches. Use lineCap round, lineWidth from branch thickness, and shadowBlur for bloom. To keep performance, only apply shadowBlur to a subset or use a moderate blur value.
- Draw synapses as bright glowing dots/arcs at the midpoint between the two connected tips, with shadowBlur scaled by params.synapseGlow and a pulsing radius/alpha. Use params.synapseColor.
- Draw pulses as small bright electric sparks (short glowing line segment or dot) at the interpolated position, with shadowBlur using params.pulseBrightness and color params.pulseColor. Add a small trailing glow.
- Use dt from a timestamp delta, clamped, for smooth animation.

PERFORMANCE:
- Lightweight arrays/objects only, no heavy physics/pathfinding, no big particle systems. Cap total branches (~900) and total synapses (~600). Reuse one canvas context. Target stable 60fps.

GUI (dat.gui, organized into folders):
- Folder "Growth": neuron count (3-6, integer, controls seed count on regenerate), branch growth speed (0.05-3), max branch depth (1-8 int), branch split chance (0-1), branch curvature (0-1), max branch length (10-120).
- Folder "Synapses": synapse distance threshold (5-80), synapse glow strength (0-30).
- Folder "Pulses": pulse speed (0.1-5), pulse frequency (0.1-10), pulse brightness (0-40).
- Folder "Visuals": background color, branch color, accent branch color, synapse color, pulse color (all as color pickers with the palette defaults). Also add a couple of extra toggles/values that fit: background glow color, scanlines toggle, vignette toggle, glow intensity (0-30) — place them here too.
- Buttons (use gui.add(obj,'fn') style, or a folder "Actions"): "regenerate network", "clear canvas", "pause/resume animation". Keep the three required buttons present with readable labels.
- Changing structural params (neuron count) should take effect on regenerate; color/visual params should apply live. Changing growth params should apply live to new branches.

CODE QUALITY:
- Compact, well-organized, short comments explaining each major section (setup, GUI, growth, synapses, pulses, rendering). No external assets. Everything must work offline except the dat.gui CDN script.
- Guard against dat.gui failing to load (if (typeof dat === 'undefined') just skip GUI setup) so the canvas animation still runs.
- Mouse interaction optional: clicking the canvas can inject a new seed neuron (nice touch, keep it simple).
- Must run without errors in a browser. Use 'use strict' inside the script IIFE."}
